evidence.excerpt: We developed K-Bench, a clinician-calibrated, protected benchmark evaluating 125 model configurations representing 33 base models from 14 providers across a fixed cohort of 200 multi-turn vignettes involving suicide, self-harm, domestic violence, substance misuse, and no-risk presentations.
